adr.description: Optional. Overrides the directory names scripts/adr/homes.js resolves ADR homes from. Every key is optional and adding this block does not bump `current` — it only renames directories an unset manifest already defaults.

localDir.description: Local ADR directory, relative to each repo's root.

sharedDir.description: Shared ADR directory, relative to the team knowledge base's knowledge/ directory.

adrDir.description: Optional per-repo override of adr.localDir — this repo's local ADR directory, relative to its own root.
